faq.changeOrder.title: Can I change my order after submitting it?
faq.changeOrder.answer: Yes! After placing an order, we perform a confirmation call to review order details with you and efficiently apply any adjustments requested before dispatch.
faq.sizing.title: How do I choose the right size?
faq.sizing.answer: A comprehensive size guide is available on every product page to assist you. Furthermore, we confirm sizing selections collectively during our validation call based on your requirements.
faq.currency.title: Can I purchase items in another currency?
faq.currency.answer: Absolutely. When checking out via supported international cards, the debited total matches the EGP conversion rate provided securely by your bank's processor.
faq.shipping.title: What are the shipping rates and times?
faq.shipping.delivery: Delivery: Standard 2-5 business days following initial call. Global routes span ~7 days.
faq.payments.title: Which payment methods are available?
faq.payments.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery and major international cards where available.
faq.returns.title: How can I request a return or exchange?
faq.returns.option1: Integrated return portal in your user dashboard.
faq.returns.option3: Forwarding queries to our service mailbox.

manufacturingDefectsDesc: For manufacturing defects appearing after use (within the first 14 days), we provide a warranty to resolve the issue according to our standards.
